title: Rangka role
description: A role an app defines (apps/<app>/roles/<role>.rk). Model permissions name roles; members get roles in an organisation.

inherits.description: Roles whose permissions this role also has

desk.description: Members with this role use the back office (false: portal only)

scope.description: Row scope: members with this role see only records whose field holds a value from `from` (contract 0010)

field.description: A field name or a list of names, e.g. outlet or [from_outlet, to_outlet]

from.description: CEL over user returning a list of record names, e.g. user.outlets
